files.src/SealIn.st:
PROGRAM SealIn
VAR_INPUT StartPB AT %I0.0 : BOOL; StopPB AT %I0.1 : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT Motor AT %Q0.0 : BOOL; END_VAR
Motor := (StartPB OR Motor) AND NOT StopPB;
END_PROGRAM

wrong.intent: puts the holding contact in parallel with Stop as well, so Stop cannot drop the motor
uses a normally open contact for Stop, so the motor cannot start until Stop is pressed
holds with a normally closed contact on Motor, so the motor drops out at once
uses a SET coil and no reset, so Stop never drops the motor
